incidents.name: OLIFE reflection deliver drain
incidents.notes: Calling OLIFE's transfer() and deliver() shrinks rSupply and tSupply so the reflection rate rises and the liquidity pair's OLIFE balance inflates without a sync(), letting the attacker swap the surplus out for WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: OLIFE 0xb5a0Ce3Acd6eC557d39aFDcbC93B07a1e1a9e3fa created 2021-06-04T16:54:29Z by 0x60a3da04d69f65774595983190970b4fbb67f6ce, unrelated to attack sender 0xfb8ef8de849079559801bff8848178640cdd41b7; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 32.2863 WBNB left the OLIFE/WBNB pair; 32.2863 WBNB x $343.14 at incidentTimestamp 1681866281 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $11,079.
